tools.name: find-free-time
tools.title: Find free time
tools.description: Find the open slots on one day of the connected Google Calendar that are long enough for a meeting, within working hours. Use when someone asks when they are free, or wants to propose times for a meeting. Returns times in the calendar's own time zone.

date.description: The day to check, as YYYY-MM-DD

durationMinutes.description: How long the meeting is, in minutes

startHour.description: When the working day starts, 0–23. Defaults to 9

endHour.description: When the working day ends, 1–24. Defaults to 17
